children.text: D1 Shape Morph — Stagger (each piece morphs independently)
Draw Morph (erase shape A → draw shape B)
Named Eases — Jelly / Wobble / Bounce / Snap
Fill Yoyo (fills on hover, empties on leave)
Draw + Fill — Overlap (fill starts at 50% of draw)
Draw + Fill — After (fill starts 0.3s after draw ends)
